name: Facet
text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme with adjustable saturation and font size as the default for EXCAVA’s interface. This maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain for long screentime, aligning with our goal of liveliness and clarity. The trade-off is that users who strongly prefer light themes will need to manually adjust settings, but the system-preference toggle we already decided on will mitigate this.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A system toggle doubles maintenance cost—every visual tweak must work in both modes. Better: pick one high-contrast dark theme as default, but let users override saturation and font size without flipping themes. Settle it by testing whether 90% of users actually need the theme toggle; if fewer than 10% change it after a week, drop the toggle and save the tech debt.
